title: Lantern and Clock
author: Odile Amberdale
blurb: Theo Oyelaran, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
